description: Collections is for Scouts with a collecting hobby: describing and growing your collection, preserving, displaying and cataloging it, collecting versus investing, and the terms, grading and organizations of your hobby.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Stamp and coin collecting are not eligible for this badge; they have their own badges.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Your collection
requirements.summary: A short written description of your collection, its history, why you enjoy it and what you have learned.

requirements.title: Growth of your collection
requirements.summary: How your collection has grown and developed.

requirements.title: Preserving and cataloging
requirements.summary: Preserving and displaying your collection, events for collectors, and your cataloging method.

requirements.title: Collecting and investing
requirements.summary: How investing and speculation relate to your kind of collection.

requirements.title: Terms, grading and value
requirements.summary: Terms used in your hobby, showing organized groups from your collection, grading and value, and collector associations.
